answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent must lock real collateral to earn a single vote, so minting a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. The rule is as plain as a fable and fully public: payouts follow verified work, not headcount. An attacker trying to surf the tide of fake identities must pre-fund each one, and a slashing clause seizes the locked opal the instant fraud is detected. Cost therefore scales linearly with every forged agent, while honest agents only risk what they already pledged.
